entries.title: Keywords first, hashtags with purpose
entries.description: "Hashtags are dead" overstates it: Instagram still recommends relevant keywords and hashtags for Search. Practical takeaway: write natural, specific keywords in your caption and bio first, then add tags that match your topic. This is ReelCoach's workflow advice, not a Meta claim that keywords always outrank hashtags or guarantee more Reels reach.
entries.sourceQuote: Making sure you include relevant keywords in your content, your caption, your bio, and your hashtags.
entries.supportingSourceTitle: Breaking Down How Instagram Search Works

entries.title: Original content comes first
entries.description: Demo guidance: favor your own footage and a distinct creative point of view. Check current recommendation eligibility in Instagram's official documentation before publishing policy guidance.

entries.title: Make every reel accessible
entries.description: Demo editorial advice: add legible captions, review automatic transcription, and keep important text away from interface overlays. This is a creative recommendation, not a guaranteed ranking factor.
